cohort: The study included 100 cervical cancer patients who underwent surgery at a tertiary hospital between January 2010 and January 2019.
finding: Surgical complications occurred in 54% of patients, and a history of cesarean section and pelvic lymphadenectomy were significant predictors, while baseline quality of life did not predict complications.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was identified as a significant predictor of surgical complications after cervical cancer surgery.
